# RemitShip

> RemitShip is an international shipping and logistics company — "Global Reach. Local Care." — offering air freight, sea cargo, express courier, customs clearance and real-time shipment tracking.

RemitShip ships documents, parcels and cargo across borders. Customers track shipments on the website with a RemitShip tracking number (format: RS followed by 8 digits, e.g. RS26000101). No account is needed to track. Public tracking shows only verified checkpoints, origin, destination, customs status and delivery estimates; private contact details are never shown.

## Pages

- [Home](https://remitship.online/): Overview of RemitShip international shipping.
- [Track a shipment](https://remitship.online/track): Look up a shipment by its RemitShip tracking number.
- [Shipping services](https://remitship.online/services): Air freight, sea freight, express courier and international shipping.
- [About RemitShip](https://remitship.online/about): Who RemitShip is and how it handles shipments.
- [Contact](https://remitship.online/contact): Reach RemitShip about shipping, tracking and service availability.

## Optional

- [Privacy policy](https://remitship.online/privacy): How RemitShip protects shipment and customer information.
- [Terms and conditions](https://remitship.online/terms): RemitShip shipment and service terms.
